# `generated_code`

Skip this file entirely. Curb never formats files marked as generated.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

### `generated_code = true`

```ini
generated_code = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```
:::

::::
